blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Review view
blocks.body:
**Track Changes** marks insertions and deletions so a second person can see what you did. **Comments** sit on a sentence. Accept or reject like a grown-up. Then save.

Do not mix two review piles on the same file (desktop comments plus a second share tool, both half-done). Pick one pile. Finish it.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You edited with Track Changes off and called it a review, or you left the copy broken, or you never wrote which way you closed the comment.

Expected: Review view shows the cycle. One accept. Comment noted. File opens clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy prime-the-pump.dita to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7/prime-the-pump-review.dita so you do not wreck the sample.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open the copy. Turn on Track Changes (Review view :  verify the label in your version).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Edit one command (a cmd line). Add a comment on the context paragraph.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Accept the edit. Leave the comment or resolve it :  write which you did in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7/review-cycle.txt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Save. The copy should open with no red error.

blocks.summary: Review view shows the cycle. One accept. Comment noted. File opens clean.

blocks.q: Track Changes is on. You edit a command. What should a reviewer see?
options: The new words marked as a change, until someone accepts or rejects them
Nothing :  typing always hides the old words forever
A new booklet file on the desktop
blocks.why: Track Changes keeps the old and the new until a person decides. That is the review.

blocks.q: You left twelve leftover insertions in a page you want to ship. First move?
options: Accept or reject each one on purpose, then save
blocks.why: Leftover marks are not a style. They are unfinished review. Finish them before you hand the file on.
